Requirements: R-18, R-11

Obligations: OB-9-1

evidence_policy: api (secret-free request and response, before/after datasource state; completion condition: datasource state stops changing or bounded timeout)

## Given
- A run-unique provider datasource `tc009-<random>` backed by a provider that answers the reindex call with Failed and an empty errors list (P-provider-failed). If no such provider exists, this is an environment gap, not a pass. Before state: progress, error, stamp, status read by raw GET.

## When
1. Trigger a manual reindex of the provider datasource.
2. Read the datasource progress/error/status after the call and after a bounded wait.

## Then
1. The recorded end state (in progress, completed, errored, or untouched) is the observation; the expected end state is open and follows owner question OQ-8, no verdict is issued.

## Self-probe notes
- Provider contract unread; the case does not invent a response shape. Inconclusive without a provider.
- The stamp written before the external call is the decided trigger-time behavior and is not a defect.
